evidence.span: Good to see continued progress on the Timber Fire. Evacuation warnings for zones MRY-D078, MRY-D085, MRY-D086, MRY-D089, MRY-D090, MRYD091,

timeline.text: Good to see continued progress on the Timber Fire. Evacuation warnings for zones MRY-D078, MRY-D085, MRY-D086, MRY-D089, MRY-D090, MRYD091, MRY-F014, MRY-F015-A, MRY-F020, MRY-F029, and MRY-F031-A have been lifted. I’m grateful to the firefighters and first responders working tirelessly in steep terrain to contain the fire and keep our communities safe.
